name: Merced County, CA
findings: Merced County has 437 nonprofit organizations. 158 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 136 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Merced County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 53 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Merced County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
